about.title: About Wired Electrical and Generators
text: Generators in stock at our Tomball showroom, and licensed electricians for panels, EV chargers, lighting and repairs.
Generac Prestige Dealer Generac's highest dealer designation. We sell, install and service Generac home standby generators.

It only comes off the units on our floor, so when they're gone, it's gone. New air-cooled Generac installs come with a free 10-year warranty, and financing is there if you want it. Permit timing depends on your city or county. The install itself is usually one day.
